correctness.rationale: Reconstructed F_A=σH_A D, F_C=σH_C D over F_2, where D is adjacent XOR and H_A,H_C are involutions (the latter complement-conjugate). Direct trigger invariance proves H_A^2=id; on a ring D has even-parity image and exactly two preimages. Hence the parity functional Phi_A(y)=Σ_i[y_i+y_(i−1)(1+y_(i+1))y_(i+2)] and Phi_C(y)=Σ_i[y_i+(1+y_(i−1))y_(i+1)(1+y_(i+2))] precisely decide whether each indexed ring output has two or zero preimages for every n>=1. The sparse pattern classification requires n>=7: A prohibits every single marker and exactly n distance-three two-marker outputs; C permits all single markers but prohibits exactly 2n distance-one-or-two pairs. Independently enumerated all 2^n inputs and target fibers for n<=9, and all sparse patterns for n=7,8,10. Finite checks corroborate rather than replace the involution/difference-map proof; no locally-eventually-onto conclusion is claimed.
